kerala.breakfast.egg-and-vegetable-omele.name: Egg & Vegetable Omelette
kerala.breakfast.egg-and-vegetable-omele.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: 2 eggs whisked with diced beans, tomatoes, onions, green chillies
steps: Finely dice the beans, tomato, onion and green chilli.
Whisk the eggs with the vegetables, salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan, pour in the mix and cook on medium until set, then flip and finish for a minute.
Toast the wholemeal bread dry and serve alongside the omelette.

kerala.breakfast.idli-swap-oats-rava-idl.name: Idli Swap: Oats-Rava Idli & Sambar
steps: Pressure-cook the toor dal with turmeric until soft and mash.
Dry-roast the oats and rava, grind the oats coarsely and mix both with yoghurt, grated carrot, salt and enough water to a thick batter; rest 10 minutes.
Simmer the diced onion, tomato, beans and half the carrot in tamarind water with coriander and chilli powders, then add the dal and cook 5 minutes.
Temper coconut oil with mustard seeds, curry leaves and asafoetida and pour over the sambar.
Steam the batter in greased idli plates for 10-12 minutes; makes 2-3 idlis.
Hard-boil the egg (10 minutes), peel and halve. Serve with the idlis and a bowl of sambar.

kerala.breakfast.lentil-adai-and-mint-ch.name: Lentil Adai & Mint Chutney
steps: Soak the dals and rice together for 3 hours (or overnight); grind coarsely with dried red chilli, asafoetida and salt.
Stir chopped onion and curry leaves into the batter.
Grind the coconut, coriander, mint, green chilli, shallots and ginger with a splash of water into a chutney.
Spread the batter into 2 medium adais on a hot tawa, drizzle a little oil and cook both sides until crisp.
Soft-boil the egg (6 minutes) and serve with the adais and a tablespoon of chutney.

kerala.breakfast.oats-upma-and-boiled-eg.name: Oats Upma & Boiled Egg
steps: Dry-roast the oats for 2-3 minutes until fragrant and set aside.
Heat the oil, pop mustard seeds and urad dal, add curry leaves, chopped ginger (keep a few slices for the tea), chilli and onion; saute until soft.
Add the diced carrot and beans with turmeric and salt, splash of water, and cook 4 minutes.
Stir in the oats with about 3/4 cup hot water; cover and cook 3-4 minutes until fluffy.
Hard-boil the egg (10 minutes), peel and halve.
Brew black tea with the reserved ginger slices, no sugar, and serve with the upma and egg.

kerala.breakfast.ragi-puttu-and-cherupay.name: Ragi Puttu & Cherupayar
kerala.breakfast.ragi-puttu-and-cherupay.basedOn: Puttu with cherupayar curry, the lighter cousin of puttu-kadala.
steps: Soak the green gram overnight (or 4 hours).
Pressure-cook the soaked green gram with turmeric and salt for 3 whistles until just tender.
Temper coconut oil with mustard seeds, dried red chilli and curry leaves; saute shallots, garlic and green chilli.
Stir in the cooked green gram with a little stock and the coconut; simmer 5 minutes to a loose curry.
Steam the puttu: sprinkle water into the salted flour until it clumps, layer in the puttu kutti with coconut and steam 5-7 minutes.
Hard-boil the egg (10 minutes), peel and halve. Serve with the ragi puttu and 3/4 cup of curry.

kerala.breakfast.sprouted-moong-salad-an.name: Sprouted Moong Salad & Poached Eggs
components: 1 bowl steamed sprouted moong tossed with chopped onions, tomato, lemon
steps: Use green gram soaked and sprouted over the previous 1-2 days.
Steam the sprouts for 5 minutes until just tender but still crunchy.
Toss the sprouts with chopped onion, tomato, cucumber, chilli, coriander, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Poach or soft-boil the eggs (3-6 minutes) and serve on top of the salad.

kerala.breakfast.whole-wheat-toast-and-b.name: Whole Wheat Toast & Boiled Eggs
kerala.breakfast.whole-wheat-toast-and-b.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
Toast the wholemeal bread dry.
Halve the eggs and season with crushed black pepper and a pinch of salt.
Brew the black tea without sugar and serve.

kerala.dinner.cherupayar-puzhukku-and-eg.name: Cherupayar Puzhukku & Egg Whites
kerala.dinner.cherupayar-puzhukku-and-eg.basedOn: Cherupayar puzhukku, green gram with coconut, the Thiruvathira-day dish.
steps: Pressure-cook the green gram with turmeric and salt until soft but still whole.
Hard-boil the eggs, peel and keep only the whites.
Grind the coconut with cumin, garlic and green chilli to a coarse paste; stir it into the gram and cook until dry.
Heat the coconut oil, pop the mustard seeds with the shallots and curry leaves and mix into the puzhukku.
Simmer the diced carrot, beans and cabbage with ginger and pepper in 400 ml water for 10 minutes to make a clear soup.
Serve the puzhukku with the egg whites and the soup; no rice.

kerala.dinner.egg-roast-and-phulka.name: Egg Roast & Phulka
kerala.dinner.egg-roast-and-phulka.basedOn: Mutta roast, eggs in a thick shallot-tomato masala.
components: Muttai roast (2 eggs in shallot-tomato gravy)
steps: Hard-boil the eggs, peel and slit them lightly.
Heat the oil and fry the sliced shallots with ginger, garlic, green chilli and curry leaves until deep golden.
Add kashmiri chilli, coriander and turmeric, then the chopped tomato; cook to a thick masala.
Add the eggs and a splash of water, coat well, finish with garam masala and cook until dry.
Steam the cauliflower florets 6 minutes and season with pepper and salt.
Roll two phulkas, puff on the tawa and serve with the egg roast and cauliflower.

kerala.dinner.fish-tikka-and-sambar-soup.name: Fish Tikka & Sambar Soup
components: 150g grilled fish fillet cubes (Neymeen or Hamour) marinated in spices
1 large bowl clear drumstick vegetable sambar (no rice)
steps: Marinate the fish cubes in kashmiri chilli, turmeric, ginger, garlic, pepper, lime juice and salt.
Pressure-cook the toor dal soft; soak the tamarind and squeeze out the pulp.
Simmer the drumstick, ash gourd and brinjal in the tamarind water with coriander, chilli powder and turmeric until tender.
Add the mashed dal, thin with water to a soupy consistency and simmer 5 minutes.
Temper mustard, fenugreek, dried chilli, asafoetida, shallots and curry leaves in coconut oil and pour over the sambar.
Knead the atta, roll one chapati and cook on the tawa.
Pan-grill the fish cubes in the oil for 3 minutes a side and serve with the sambar soup and chapati.
kerala.dinner.fish-tikka-and-sambar-soup.swapNote: Fish fillet can be Neymeen, Kalava, or Basa.

kerala.dinner.grilled-kerala-chicken-and.name: Grilled Kerala Chicken & Thoran
components: 150g boneless chicken breast marinated in nadan spices
steps: Marinate the chicken with chilli powder, turmeric, pepper, coriander, garam masala, ginger, garlic, lime and salt for 15 minutes.
Knead the atta, roll one chapati and cook on the tawa.
Pop the mustard seeds in coconut oil, add the shallots and curry leaves, then the diced snake gourd and salt.
Cover and cook 8 minutes, then stir in the coconut crushed with cumin and green chilli and cook dry.
Pan-grill the chicken in the oil on medium heat about 6 minutes a side until cooked through.
Rest the chicken, slice and serve with the thoran and chapati.

kerala.dinner.paneer-and-vegetable-stir-.name: Paneer & Vegetable Stir Fry
components: 100g paneer cubes stir-fried with capsicum, French beans, and shallots
steps: Knead the atta, roll one chapati and cook on the tawa.
Cut the paneer into cubes, the capsicum into strips and the beans into short lengths.
Heat the oil and fry the shallots, ginger, garlic, green chilli and curry leaves until fragrant.
Add the beans and capsicum and stir-fry 5 minutes on high heat.
Add the paneer, turmeric, chilli powder, pepper and salt and toss 3 minutes until lightly browned.
Serve hot with the chapati.

kerala.dinner.vegetable-egg-scramble-and.name: Vegetable Egg Scramble & Soup
components: 3 eggs (1 whole + 2 whites) scrambled with beans, carrots, and onions
steps: Simmer the cabbage, half the carrot, ginger, garlic and curry leaves in 400 ml water with salt and pepper for 10 minutes for a clear broth.
Knead the atta, roll one chapati and cook on the tawa.
Separate two eggs and beat the whites with one whole egg, turmeric, pepper and salt.
Saute the onion, green chilli, chopped beans and remaining carrot in the oil for 4 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and scramble on low heat until just set.
Serve the scramble with the chapati and the broth topped with coriander leaves.

kerala.dinner.yellow-dal-spinach-and-boi.name: Yellow Dal Spinach & Boiled Eggs
kerala.dinner.yellow-dal-spinach-and-boi.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
steps: Cook the moong dal with turmeric and 300 ml water until soft.
Hard-boil the eggs, peel and halve.
Add the chopped cheera, garlic and green chilli to the dal and simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the coconut crushed with cumin and bring back to a boil.
Temper mustard seeds, dried chilli, shallots and curry leaves in coconut oil and pour over the dal.
Roll one chapati, cook on the tawa and serve with the dal and pepper-sprinkled eggs.

kerala.lunch.avoli-curry-and-kovakka.name: Avoli Curry & Kovakka
kerala.lunch.avoli-curry-and-kovakka.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: Primary: 1 portion Avoli (Pomfret) cooked with Kudampuli and green chillies
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Clean the pomfret; soak the kudampuli in warm water and grind the chilli powders, turmeric and a little water to a paste.

Heat coconut oil in a clay pot, splutter fenugreek seeds, sauté shallots, ginger, garlic and curry leaves, add the chilli paste, the kudampuli with its water and salt, then slide in the fish and simmer 12-15 min until the gravy thickens.

Dice the vegetable finely for the kovakka mezhukkupuratti; splutter mustard seeds in coconut oil, add shallots, garlic and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, and stir-fry uncovered until tender and lightly browned.
Whisk the yoghurt with water, crushed ginger, green chilli, curry leaves and salt to make the sambharam; chill until serving.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the kovakka mezhukkupuratti, the pomfret, and the sambharam alongside.

kerala.lunch.ayala-tawa-sear-and-cheera-.name: Ayala Tawa Sear & Cheera Thoran
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Marinate the mackerel with turmeric, chilli powder, crushed pepper, lime juice and salt for 15 min.
Heat 1 tsp coconut oil on a tawa and sear the fish 4-5 min per side with curry leaves until the skin is crisp and the flesh flakes.

Strip and wash the leaves for the cheera thoran; splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil, add shallots and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, cover and cook until just tender, and finish with grated coconut.
Whisk the yoghurt with water, crushed ginger, green chilli, curry leaves and salt to make the sambharam; chill until serving.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the cheera thoran, the mackerel, and the sambharam alongside.

kerala.lunch.chemmeen-ularthiyathu-and-p.name: Chemmeen Ularthiyathu & Pavakka
kerala.lunch.chemmeen-ularthiyathu-and-p.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
kerala.lunch.chemmeen-ularthiyathu-and-p.basedOn: Chemmeen ularthiyathu, prawns roasted dry with shallots, curry leaves and pepper.
components: Primary: 150g Chemmeen (Prawns) sautéed with shallots, curry leaves, and cracked pepper
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Marinate the prawns with turmeric, chilli powder and salt.
Sauté shallots, ginger, garlic and curry leaves in coconut oil, add the prawns and crushed black pepper, and toss 5-6 min until dry and coated.

Dice the vegetable finely for the pavakka mezhukkupuratti; splutter mustard seeds in coconut oil, add shallots, garlic and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, and stir-fry uncovered until tender and lightly browned.
For the moru kachiyathu, whisk yoghurt with water and turmeric, warm gently without boiling, and temper with mustard seeds, fenugreek, shallots, ginger, green chilli, dried chilli and curry leaves.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the pavakka mezhukkupuratti, the prawns, and the moru kachiyathu alongside.

kerala.lunch.chicken-chukka-and-cheera-t.name: Chicken Chukka & Cheera Thoran
kerala.lunch.chicken-chukka-and-cheera-t.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: 150g dry chicken chukka cooked with crushed black pepper, shallots, and curry leaves
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Marinate the chicken with turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder and salt for 15 min.
Sauté shallots, ginger, garlic and curry leaves in coconut oil, add the chicken and cook covered 15 min, then uncover, add crushed black pepper and garam masala and roast until dry and dark.

Strip and wash the leaves for the cheera thoran; splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil, add shallots and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, cover and cook until just tender, and finish with grated coconut.

For the rasam, simmer tamarind water with crushed tomato, garlic, pepper, cumin, turmeric and salt (extra cumin) for 10 min, temper with mustard seeds, dried chilli and asafoetida, and add coriander leaves.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the cheera thoran, the chicken, and the rasam alongside.

kerala.lunch.chicken-pepper-roast-and-mu.name: Chicken Pepper Roast & Murungayila
kerala.lunch.chicken-pepper-roast-and-mu.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: 1 cup Chicken pepper roast (dry preparation with shallots)
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Marinate the chicken with turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder and salt for 15 min.
Sauté shallots, ginger, garlic and curry leaves in coconut oil, add the chicken and cook covered 15 min, then uncover, add crushed black pepper and garam masala and roast until dry and dark.

Strip and wash the leaves for the murungayila thoran; splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil, add shallots and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, cover and cook until just tender, and finish with grated coconut.

For the rasam, simmer tamarind water with crushed tomato, garlic, pepper, cumin, turmeric and salt (extra tomato) for 10 min, temper with mustard seeds, dried chilli and asafoetida, and add coriander leaves.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the murungayila thoran, the chicken, and the rasam alongside.

kerala.lunch.kalava-tawa-roast-and-murun.name: Kalava (Grouper) Tawa Roast & Murungayila
kerala.lunch.kalava-tawa-roast-and-murun.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: Primary: 150g Kalava fillet pan-seared with turmeric, pepper, and lime
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Marinate the grouper fillet with turmeric, chilli powder, crushed pepper, lime juice and salt for 15 min.
Heat 1 tsp coconut oil on a tawa and sear the fish 4-5 min per side with curry leaves until the skin is crisp and the flesh flakes.

Strip and wash the leaves for the murungayila thoran; splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil, add shallots and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, cover and cook until just tender, and finish with grated coconut.

For the rasam, simmer tamarind water with crushed tomato, garlic, pepper, cumin, turmeric and salt (extra tomato) for 10 min, temper with mustard seeds, dried chilli and asafoetida, and add coriander leaves.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the murungayila thoran, the grouper fillet, and the rasam alongside.

kerala.lunch.mathi-roast-and-padavalanga.name: Mathi Roast & Padavalanga Thoran
kerala.lunch.mathi-roast-and-padavalanga.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: Primary: 3 fresh sardines (Mathi) pan-seared with turmeric, pepper, Kudampuli
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Marinate the sardines with turmeric, chilli powder, crushed pepper, lime juice and salt for 15 min.
Heat 1 tsp coconut oil on a tawa and sear the fish 4-5 min per side with curry leaves until the skin is crisp and the flesh flakes.

Dice the vegetable finely for the padavalanga thoran; splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil, add shallots and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, cover and cook until just tender, and finish with grated coconut.

For the rasam, simmer tamarind water with crushed tomato, garlic, pepper, cumin, turmeric and salt (extra cumin) for 10 min, temper with mustard seeds, dried chilli and asafoetida, and add coriander leaves.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the padavalanga thoran, the sardines, and the rasam alongside.

kerala.snack.green-tea-and-roasted-makha.name: Green tea & Roasted makhana spiced with turmeric & salt
components: 1 cup roasted makhana (foxnuts) spiced with turmeric & salt
steps: Steep the green tea bag in a cup of just-boiled water for 3 minutes, then remove the bag.
Heat the coconut oil in a pan, add the makhana and roast on low heat for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring, until crisp.
Sprinkle with turmeric and salt, toss well and serve with the green tea.

kerala.snack.inji-chaya-and-almonds.name: Inji Chaya & Almonds
steps: Crush the ginger, boil it in a cup of water for 2 minutes, add the tea leaves, simmer a minute and strain.
Dry-roast the almonds in a pan for 2 to 3 minutes until fragrant.
Serve the warm almonds alongside the drink.

kerala.snack.inji-chaya-and-boiled-salte.name: Inji Chaya & Boiled, salted edamame or chickpeas
components: Boiled, salted edamame or chickpeas (1/2 cup)
steps: Crush the ginger, boil it in a cup of water for 2 minutes, add the tea leaves, simmer a minute and strain.
Boil the frozen edamame in salted water for 4 to 5 minutes, then drain.
Sprinkle with salt and serve warm with the tea (boiled chickpeas work as a swap).

kerala.snack.kattan-chaya-and-boiled-gre.name: Kattan Chaya & Boiled green gram
steps: Boil a cup of water, add the tea leaves, simmer 2 minutes, strain and serve unsweetened.
Reheat the pre-boiled green gram in a pan with a splash of water for 3 to 4 minutes.
Season with salt and serve warm with the drink.

kerala.snack.kattan-chaya-and-kadala-sun.name: Kattan Chaya & Kadala sundal
kerala.snack.kattan-chaya-and-kadala-sun.basedOn: Kadala sundal, tempered black chickpeas, the classic evening nibble.
steps: Boil a cup of water, add the tea leaves, simmer 2 minutes, strain and serve unsweetened.
Heat the coconut oil, pop the mustard seeds, then add the curry leaves and dried red chilli.
Toss in the pre-boiled kadala with salt and heat through for 3 to 4 minutes.
Stir in the grated coconut, take off the heat and serve warm with the tea.

kerala.snack.kattan-chaya-and-roasted-ca.name: Kattan Chaya & Roasted cashews/almonds
steps: Boil a cup of water, add the tea leaves, simmer 2 minutes, strain and serve unsweetened.
Dry-roast the cashews and almonds in a pan for 2 to 3 minutes until lightly golden.
Serve the nuts warm with the tea.

kerala.snack.kattan-kappi-and-roasted-ma.name: Kattan Kappi & Roasted makhana
steps: Boil a cup of water, stir in the coffee powder, let it steep a minute and strain into a cup; no sugar.
Heat the coconut oil in a pan, add the makhana and roast on low heat for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring, until crisp.
Sprinkle with salt and serve with the drink.
